name: Differences-based Compression
definition: A compression scheme that loads data for multiple elements, expands stored differences into 16-bit values, and adds them to a base value to obtain final values, using pre-computed shift patterns for variable bit depths.
summary: Differences-based Compression stores quantized differences relative to a block base value, distinguished by using pre-computed shift patterns to efficiently handle variable bit-depths during SIMD decompression.
